faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Multi Tasking Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Multi Tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed High School or an equivalent examination to be eligible for the Multi Tasking Staff position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Multi Tasking Staff position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Multi Tasking Staff post is 25 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Multi Tasking Staff role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 15,800/- per month, corresponding to PB-1 Rs. 5200-20200 + Grade Pay Rs. 1800.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email with complete bio-data and required documents to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Multi Tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve document verification followed by a physical interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or project-based job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110029.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with no prior experience apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the eligibility criteria for the Multi Tasking Staff position state that no experience is required (Nil).
